paragraphs: The M440i xDrive is the performance-oriented petrol flagship of the 4 Series range, sitting above the 420i and 430i. It uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid (MHEV) assistance, fitted from the G22/G23/G26 generation's launch in 2020 through to the present day. The B58 is BMW's current-generation turbocharged straight-six, widely regarded as a robust and well-engineered unit that replaced the earlier N55 in the BMW line-up.
about.boldParagraph: The M440i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
